sources.title: BEYBLADE X UX-22 Vanish Lucifer WW Deploys a Near-Circular Defense Barrier While Spinning
sources.snippet:
Japanese toy company TAKARA TOMY is expanding its BEYBLADE X lineup with the new Defense Type UX-22 Vanish Lucifer WW. Its standout gimmick harnesses rotational force to deploy barriers around the outside of the metal Blade, gradually forming a near-perfect circle that significantly improves its ability to withstand incoming attacks. The starter also includes a Long Winder Launcher. Priced at 2,500 yen including tax, it is scheduled for release on December 26, 2026. [...] TAKARA TOMY BEYBLADE X UX-22 Starter Vanish Lucifer WW  
 Price: 2,500 yen including tax  
 Release Date: December 26, 2026

via： TAKARA TOMY [...] from opposing Beyblades. Rather than relying solely on a thick, heavy Blade for protection, this design dynamically changes shape as it spins.
